_source: DRAFT 1 of specs/vt_engine_rules.json (Spec Kit 071). Every value cites a file+cell (files in ../reference/zips/vt/) or a decision id in spec.md §9. SR = Sales_Review_YTD 2026.xlsx, AL = Matrix - Agent List.xlsx, RPT = November 2026 - VT Report.xlsx, BI = BI Active Fitted 101126.xlsx, SM = Scheduled & Missed 101126.xlsx, WR = specs/vt-analytics/workbook-rules.md.

_changes.why: new module; owner: 'you will get all the answers from the files I gave you'

vtBiFitted._evidence: BI row 1 headers C, T, V, Y, AS, L; footer A19406. VAS BI has none of C/T/V (current-state B3).

vtSchedMissed._evidence: SM row 1 headers U, R, C, S; footer row 1080.

vtOpeningBook._evidence: RPT 'Schedulers Data'!A1:K1. Decision A6 (sale dates only; Result/GWP/Scheduler/contact never stored).

bi._evidence: duplicate headers B/R, X/AD, Y/AK (WR 1.1); X==AD on 1,107/1,107 VT lines; O==Q on 1,103/1,107

columns.discardAll: every column not listed above (customer name, mobile, registration, chassis, box, account/contract numbers, consultants, fitment partner, last modified by)
columns.dateSerial: Excel 1900 serial, integer part; text dates refused

_vtUnitTypesEvidence: BI Y in this set = 1,107 lines / 1,104 cases = RPT Q paste column exactly (WR 1.1). 'Recovery Service' excluded (A9).

status.acrossExtracts: newer extract decides between missed and scheduled
status._evidence: WR 3.1: 1,756/1,756 cases; 3 SM-Missed∩BI and 1 SM-Scheduled∩BI shown Fitted; 178 rows keep earlier statuses. A7, A8.

saleDay.openingBook: takes RPT 'Schedulers Data'!B for its cases
saleDay.openingWithoutDate: null — in play, never counted as a sale on any day
saleDay._evidence: F8: Case Number order vs sale date has 5 inversions in 2,024; all 1,309 non-cancelled Current sales are present in the day's inputs. A5, A6.

identity.unmatched: excluded from agent rows; counted on the receipt and in floor.unmatched
identity._evidence: WR 3.2 and 4.1: 38 exact + 3 first+last (CB14, CB346, CB354) + 1 one-letter (CB342); 7 on no sheet (49 BI + 17 SM cases). A10.

leadSources._evidence: WR 3.3 (partner table; Referral split 177/179; PD - Lead Gen hidden items = the 4 partners). A11.

teams._evidence: AL VT!E (Predictive 22, Digital 17, Scheduling 6, Referral 3); VT!I '-' on the 6 Scheduling rows; D7-d.

periods.cycleKeyBy: month the cycle ends in (cycle-YYYY-MM, worker/src/cycle.mjs)
periods.workingDay: Mon-Fri and not dataOnlyDay (SA public holidays + extraHolidays)
periods._evidence: SR row 2 ('26 Oct to 25 Nov 2026'); RPT A boundary 26 Oct; SR 'Last 5 Days Run Rate' 19/10-24/10, 02/11-07/11 (Mon-Sat); SR dialing days Sep 22 / Oct 20 = weekdays minus holidays (Nov 22 vs 23 recorded, A4); RPT L formula and TODAY=11 Nov on 101126 files (F12).

guards._evidence: decision FR-006 (BI is cumulative within a cycle per its footer 'CurrentSalesMonth is Current'; S&M is a live snapshot)

_vatNote: must equal MTD_RULES.vat (verify-vt-rules); used only for C21 Fitted value

reports.inPlay: sold in cycle OR (sold earlier AND (open at any time in cycle OR fitted in cycle))

columns.label: Rollover
columns.f: count(set where saleDay < cycle.from or saleDay null)

columns.label: Cancelled
columns.f: count(set where status=cancelled) or null when cancelledFrom is null

columns.label: Fitted Rate %
columns._evidence: RPT PD sheets col I (GETPIVOTDATA ratio over all rows)

columns.label: Fitments done
columns.f: count(events to=fitted, on fittedDay in window)

columns.label: Working days
columns.f: working days from max(cycle.from, agent start) to last extract

columns.label: Fitted value (incl VAT, Charge Amount basis)
columns._evidence: F9: not the bundle-price GWP; labelled

reports.totals: sum of counts; rates = ratio of sums

drivers.label: Target Achievement
drivers.target: Agent List Target (AL VT!I) for the cycle's list
drivers.note: How close your sales per working day come to your target.

drivers.label: Fitment Rate
drivers.note: Out of every 100 of your sales in play this month, how many are fitted.

drivers.label: Missed Rate
drivers.note: How many of your sales missed their fitment appointment. Lower is better.

drivers.label: Fitted vs target
drivers.note: Fitments done this month against what your target would fit.

rating._weightsWhy: volume first as in VAS; fitment is the revenue event; missed is the main avoidable loss; fitted count is a cross-check (partly double-counts) so it carries the least. Total 100. spec §6.

notScored.gwp: D7-a: Charge Amount x VAT equals RPT GWP on 328/1,104; budget Avg GWP (SR VT Digital!N35 166, VT Referrals!N15 R199, VT Predictive!N60 169) is on the bundle-price basis; SM has no amount
notScored.hrsAhead: D7-b: scheduler's queue, not the seller's
notScored.attendance_talk_qa_conversion_optins: D7-c: not in the VT files

rating._bandsEvidence: same as specs/composite_rules.json bands ('it must match vas analytics')

budgetFallback: latest earlier cycle; the card names the cycle used

_cells.spd: SR 'VT Digital'!N20; 'VT Referrals'!N12; 'VT Predictive'!N46:N48 — equal AL VT!I (F1)
_cells.hrsShare: SR 'VT Scheduling'!A41, A46, A51, A56 labels
